title: Final Production Readiness Assessment knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the purpose of “Final Production Readiness Assessment”?
options: Assume the reference output guarantees behavior across all MongoDB versions and deployment types.

Final Production Readiness Assessment is an operational control that should produce verifiable evidence: current state, chosen procedure, expected result, alert or rollback path, and a short record of what was checked. Distinguish Atlas-managed controls from self-managed responsibilities.
Skip validation and run the broadest possible operation immediately in production.
Disable access controls and embed connection credentials in source code to avoid configuration work.
